targets.authors: Teimouri, Y., Plonsky, L., & Tabandeh, F.
targets.title: L2 grit: Passion and perseverance for second-language learning.
targets.evidence_quote: This study is a conceptual replication of Teimouri et al.’s (2022) investigation into the validity of the second language (L2) grit scale (the L2-Grit scale).
targets.outcome_quote: This conceptual replication study re-examined the reliability and validity of the L2-Grit scale. Reliability and construct validity were assessed using reliability analysis, CFA, and stepwise regression analysis. The results were somewhat different from those of the initial study, but taken together they lend support to the internal consistency and construct validity of the L2-Grit scale.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion explicitly integrates the differing individual results into overall support for the scale’s reliability and validity, the original claim being replicated. This overall assessment governs the outcome despite different predictor associations.

reasoning: The author explicitly uses a different Japanese university sample to assess generalizability of the named earlier validation study. Other grit and measurement references are background.
